system.cost: One Cost Category Higher Than Drug/Toxin Cost
system.description:
These microbots carry tiny needles and a small chemical or toxin payload. The swarmanoid can attack targets, cumulatively causing only 1 DV but injecting the target with a single dose (see Swarmanoid Attacks, next column). A standard-size swarm can carry 5 doses at a time.

Source: Eclipse Phase Transhuman, p. 213.
